wf.phase.meeting_engagement.name: Meeting Engagement
wf.phase.meeting_engagement.desc: Forward echelons clash in mobile contact before either side completes full line deployment.
wf.phase.prepared_assault.name: Prepared Assault
wf.phase.prepared_assault.desc: Staff-planned offensive waves push into defensive belts with synchronized fire and logistics.
wf.phase.armoured_breakthrough.name: Armoured Breakthrough
wf.phase.armoured_breakthrough.desc: Concentrated mechanized and tank spearheads rupture the main line and exploit open flanks.
wf.phase.flanking_envelopment.name: Flanking Envelopment
wf.phase.flanking_envelopment.desc: Converging axes widen the combat front and strip away the protection of entrenched positions.
wf.phase.artillery_barrage.name: Artillery & Air Barrage
wf.phase.artillery_barrage.desc: Heavy long-range fire, strike sorties and drones dominate the sector and suppress frontline troops.
wf.phase.urban_grind.name: Urban Attrition
wf.phase.urban_grind.desc: Close-quarters street fighting slows armoured breakthroughs and favours entrenched defenders.
wf.phase.elastic_defence.name: Elastic Defence
wf.phase.elastic_defence.desc: Deeply dug-in units absorb the opening blow and punish advancing formations with prepared crossfire.
wf.phase.desperate_counterattack.name: Counter-Attack
wf.phase.desperate_counterattack.desc: Defending reserves strike back into an overextended assault, shattering attacker momentum.
wf.phase.pocket_collapse.name: Pocket Collapse
wf.phase.pocket_collapse.desc: Cut-off formations with exhausted supplies lose cohesion rapidly under converging fire.
wf.note.initial_contact: Initial contact — formations deploying into line
